messages:
alisa (AE): Kickoff: MerchantX evaluating POC to migrate from CompetitorY -> Redwood. Main asks: prompt parity, output deltas, token billing, auth/SSO, data residency. Can SEs triage?

Matt (SE): On it. Quick notes: CompetitorY returns tokens_collected header + choices[0].text style. Redwood supports streaming + function/tool-calls; mapping required.

Tori Ops: POC infra question — do they want Hosted for speed or Dedicated for SLA & isolation? I pinged Legal about contract timing.

Raj ML: Prompt parity is the tricky bit — model family, temperature, stop tokens, and tokenization. CompetitorY uses byte-level BPE so our token counts can differ up to ~7% on long prompts. Recommend running a prompt-delta eval set.

Anya (Security): They'll send a security questionnaire. Need IdP metadata for SSO, and confirm if PHI/PII will be processed. If they require CMK/KMS, that pushes to Private and adds ~4w for integration.

Matt (SE): Practical mapping snippet to share with their devs: 
```
# example shim: convert competitor call -> redwood generate
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-7b", "input":"${competitor_prompt}","max_tokens":256}'
```
Note: add `?stream=true` for streaming responses. Also map competitor `choices[].finish_reason` -> Redwood `finish_reason`.

alisa (AE): Pricing Q: they asked whether billing is per-token vs per-response and if there's a migration credit. Our hosted product bills per-token; Dedicated supports committed throughput / custom pricing. I can loop in pricing.

Matt (SE): For their rough workload (avg 400 tokens/req, 30k req/day) hosted pricing estimate shared offline. I'll produce a simple calc and include tokenization delta sensitivity.

Raj ML: Heads up — CompetitorY applies a post-filter that silently drops profanity responses. That difference caused false negatives in one acceptance test during their internal migration. We should include policy/behavior diffs in the acceptance criteria.

Tori Ops: POC checklist (MerchantX): network allowlist (IP ranges), sample prompt set (50), SSO metadata, sample payloads, acceptance criteria: latency p95 < 350ms, top-1 alignment >= 95% on the evaluation set, billing validation.

Anya (Security): I'll send our security questionnaire + SOC report. Also flag: is egress logging ok for them? If not, Dedicated/Private required.

Matt (SE): I'll prepare a smoke plan: 1) 1:1 mapping for 100 prompts 2) tokenization diff report 3) three canonical prompts we expect divergence on and proposed mitigations (prompt rewriting, pre/post filters).

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for branch poc/merchantx-mapping — build 2.1 queued :rocket:

alisa (AE): Great — I'll compile the asks and set a call with MerchantX tomorrow 10am PT. Meeting invite + preliminary checklist coming.
